name: Parlor
short: Every game and bit of fun: guess the game, emoji game, twenty questions, adventures, judge, critiques, roasts and trivia writing.
description: Built on the Claude cog: guessgame has Gemini paint a game from the server's library for everyone to guess, emojigame spells one out in emoji, twentyq runs twenty questions in a thread, adventure runs a group text adventure in a thread, judge settles an argument in ButlerBot's voice, critique reviews a screenshot, roast pokes fun at a game library (others only if they opted in), and maketrivia writes lists for Red's trivia game. Replaces the ButlerFun cog and copies its saved data over once.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores each member's game win counts, adventure character bio and whether they've opted in to roasts, plus which threads are running adventures. Messages and pictures used by these games are sent to Anthropic's API (and scene descriptions to Google's Gemini) and not stored by this cog.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Parlor! It needs the Claude cog; guessgame also needs Gemini, and the games use GameManager's library when it has at least 3 games. Unload ButlerFun first if it's loaded.
author: Quillshot
